description: Perform a Robust One-Way ANOVA on the Titanic passenger age data to compare age differences across passenger classes. The dataset 'TitanicSurvival.csv' is located in '~/Documents/Jamovi/'. Open this file in Jamovi. Run a One-Way ANOVA with 'age' as the Dependent Variable and 'passengerClass' as the Grouping Variable. Check the assumption of Homogeneity of Variance (Levene's test). Since variances are likely unequal, use Welch's ANOVA (under Variances) and the Games-Howell post-hoc test. Save the project as '~/Documents/Jamovi/Titanic_Age_Analysis.omv'. Finally, create a text report at '~/Documents/Jamovi/anova_report.txt' reporting the Levene's p-value, Welch's F statistic, Welch's p-value, and the p-value for the specific post-hoc comparison between 1st and 3rd class.
